items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Lou Irwin did one for me, he booked me on a show with Jerome Kern who put on a show with all the songs he had written in Hollywood and I was one of the performers that was in it

ctx.x: it ain't even funny. Never mind. I don't mind that because I figure I'd get it on the next job.

Lou Irwin did one for me, he booked me on a show with Jerome Kern who put on a show with all the songs he had written in Hollywood and I was one of the performers that was in it with Louis Prima and Dick Powell and Robert Montgomery and Fred Astaire, with all these people in this show. He books me in there and would you believe that the man that puts on the shows, it's like the aged father show that you put on -- he was the one that got me to my agent, but my agent don't know that I'm going to bump into this man…

to get another agent. I says, "Why?" He says, "You could have got more money than what you did. You could have got better than $750 (I think it was) for this show. He just didn't fight enough for it." I says, "Really?" I says, "That's all right. I'm getting more now than what I'm doing -- for more than what I'm doing now. I'll make it up some other time to clear my point of it." But I never did tell Lou about that. I just made it from that point on that I'll set a salary for him to go by instead of him setting…
